program_name: Kraken Affiliate Program (Krak card commissions 'coming soon')
application_conditions: Two tracks: 'Direct with Kraken' (in-house, creators/KOLs; application form on the page: email, social links, target countries, Kraken Public ID, relationship manager, prior exchange experience, preferred contact method; 'We reply within 5 business days') and Impact (media networks, content sites, traditional affiliates; sign-up via app.impact.com campaign Kraken.brand). Support centre (2025-12-16): sites and apps must be pre-approved. Terms: https://www.kraken.com/legal/affiliate-agreement (read 2026-11-24).
paid_action: Commissions on 'eligible activity from users who sign up via your link' — ongoing activity, 'not just their first deposit'. Products currently covered: Kraken Consumer, Kraken Pro (spot, margin, futures), Kraken DEX (up to 50%), Kraken Prop (25%). Support centre: revenue share on 'spot and futures trade fees, spot margin opening fees and spot margin rollover fees'; funding rates and conversion fees excluded. Krak (debit card) and Kraken Earn: still 'Coming soon' on 2026-11-24 ('Krak affiliate commissions are coming soon') — the card is NOT commissionable.
validation_conditions: Eligible activity not defined on the page; rates 'vary by product, region, and affiliate profile' and are negotiated at onboarding (rev share, CPA). Geographic restrictions mentioned generically.

commission.model_note: Revenue share up to 50% on eligible volume for exchange products; rev share or CPA negotiated per partner. No rate published for the Krak/Kraken Card (coming soon).
commission.tiers_note: 'Up to' headline rate for exchange products; the card product is listed without a rate.

payout.threshold: Not stated (in-house track: 'monthly by default, or on-demand at threshold', amount unpublished)
payout.method: In-house track: USDC to the partner's Kraken account; Impact track: fiat to a bank account (support centre: bank's default currency; the /affiliate FAQ says Impact payees 'can choose fiat or USDC' — pages disagree)
payout.frequency: Monthly by default (in-house, /affiliate); the Affiliate Agreement says fees are paid 'on a weekly basis' with a report within 7 days; the support centre says funds show by the 15th of the following month and are paid on the 29th — three official pages, three cadences
payout.cancellation_note: Agreement: Kraken may reverse, claw back, withhold or set off fees for invalid referrals, fraud or error; Kraken may terminate immediately on written notice, the affiliate on 30 days' notice.

rules_note: Affiliate Agreement (kraken.com/legal/affiliate-agreement, read 2026-11-24; no effective date printed): contracting entity Payward, Inc.; bars deceptive or fraudulent methods, charging any fee to customers, framing Kraken content; marketing emails must comply with CAN-SPAM and other anti-spam laws; trademarks licensed only to establish the links; attribution 'final and binding' to Kraken; no cookie window, no country exclusions, no paid-search or brand-bidding rule in the agreement. Support centre: Brave and ad blockers break attribution; sites must be pre-approved. Partners receive 'a unique referral link and tracking pixel'. Separate personal Krak Referrals programme (support centre, 2026-10-01): $10 each to referrer and referee, EEA only, 'ending soon and no longer accepting new referrals, except in the EEA'.
allowed_countries_note: Not listed; the application asks which countries the affiliate targets; the agreement has no country list. Card commissions not yet available in any region.

evidence.title: Kraken Affiliate Program (kraken.com/affiliate)
evidence.excerpt: Re-read 2026-11-24, unchanged: 'Earn up to 50% commission', rates 'vary by product, region, and affiliate profile'. Consumer / Pro / DEX up to 50%, Prop 25%; Krak debit card and Kraken Earn 'Coming soon'; FAQ: 'Krak affiliate commissions are coming soon.' Direct track (USDC, monthly or on-demand at threshold) or Impact track (fiat). Unique referral link and tracking pixel.

Affiliate Agreement read for the first time on 2026-11-24 (Payward, Inc.; clawbacks; weekly payment wording that contradicts the monthly wording on /affiliate and the support centre).
